title: The Swapped Room Keys
story: Friday evening brought a rush to the Gull's Rest Inn: four guests checked in within ten minutes, all talking at once about the traffic. Somewhere in the hubbub, the room keys got swapped on the front desk. Priya has returned forty-one umbrellas to forty-one owners, and she is not about to lose track of four guests. Who is staying in which room, and where is each guest from?

texts: Amara is from neither Boston nor Portland.
Of Vito and Amara, one is staying in the Puffin Room and the other is staying in the Gull Room.
The guest from Boston is staying in either the Puffin or the Heron Room.
Of Vito and Kit, one is from Boston and the other is from Albany.
The guest in the Heron Room is from either Hartford or Portland.
